privacy.collected_data_notes: Mozilla Account sign-in and Sync are optional and user-controlled. After sign-in, bookmarks, browsing history, open tabs, saved website usernames/passwords, payment methods, region-eligible addresses, and Floorp notes are enabled for Sync by default and can be disabled individually. Sync records are end-to-end encrypted on device before transmission; Mozilla Sync stores account-associated ciphertext and cannot decrypt the content. The declaration conservatively treats the corresponding content categories as collected and linked because Sync stores them off-device on an ongoing, account-associated basis. Other User Content covers account authentication data, saved logins, notes, and bookmark metadata; Sensitive Info is not used as a password category. Floorp disables its inherited Glean, MetricKit, Sentry, sponsored-content, and advertising-attribution upload paths. The Usage Data and Diagnostics rows instead cover the integrated Mozilla Account service's disclosed operational, interaction, performance, and error processing, including its third-party error service. Search History is declared because normal browsing-history records can contain searches and can be synchronized. Search-suggestion requests sent in real time to the user's selected search provider are governed by that provider and are not retained by Floorp; open-web page traffic is outside this declaration. No declared data is used for tracking.
privacy.live_verification: Before external submission, publish the policy changes required by docs/floorp-ios-app-privacy.md, then confirm both the live privacy policy and App Store Connect match this exact tracking answer and disclosure set.

export_compliance.exemption_notes: Industry-standard AES-256-CBC and HMAC-SHA256 implemented by bundled Mozilla Application Services provide Firefox Sync end-to-end encryption; TLS protects transport; CryptoKit SHA-256 verifies fixed digests for the app-bundled WebExtension packages, whose bundle integrity is also covered by Apple code signing. No proprietary or non-standard cryptographic algorithm is used. The exemption and ITSAppUsesNonExemptEncryption=false must match the App Store Connect export-compliance determination.
